name: PrismaticBurst-TS-TW

frames.best_why: Boldest pink and teal rays reach every edge, giving the fullest burst of the six frames.

tagline: Rays of pink and teal light fan out from a dark centre.
summary: A full-bleed shader shoots soft rays of magenta, teal and blue outward from a black centre and slowly turns them. The colours cycle, giving a dark page a glowing light-burst backdrop.
appearance: Rays of magenta, teal and deep blue fan out from a dark middle and reach the edges of the stage. The beams are soft and blurred, brightest near the centre, with black gaps between them.
behaviour: The fan of rays rotates slowly and its colours drift, some beams brightening as others dim. It runs from the moment it loads and never comes to rest.
demo_content: Six pink, purple and cyan rays bursting from the middle on black.
search_phrases: pink and teal rays from center
energy burst backdrop for a hero
use_when: A launch or event page needs a loud, colourful glow behind big headline type.
avoid_when: Busy moving rays compete with small text and feel like noise on calm, content-heavy pages.
customise: Intensity, speed, colour list, ray count, distortion, blend mode and animation mode are props; the shader itself needs a source edit.
weight_why: A full-screen fragment shader marching 44 steps per pixel on every frame.

a11y.note: Pure canvas effect with nothing to label, and it ignores reduced-motion preferences.

props.name: offset
props.type: { x?: number | string; y?: number | string }

polish_why: Vivid, well-blended rays with smooth colour cycling; the flat black centre is familiar.
